title: Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.18723v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong capabilities as generalist agents that perceive, reason, and act in interactive environments. Yet real-time environments such as video games demand both deliberate control for exploration and split-second reactions to fast-moving hazards. Existing agents struggle to handle both: relying solely on direct VLM actions is too slow for sudden events, whereas delegating execution to fixed scripts leaves the agent blind at the moment of action, leading to frequent misfires whenever the scene shifts. Humans overcome this by pairing normal conscious control with conditioned reflexes-while the mind handles deliberate actions and shapes reflex rules, the reflex itself still relies on live vision to make the final instant decision. translated_title: 以意图行动，以视觉反应：面向实时视觉语言模型智能体的视觉条件反射
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型作为在交互环境中进行感知、推理和行动的通用智能体，已展现出强大的能力。然而，诸如电子游戏等实时环境既要求用于探索的深思熟虑的控制，也要求对快速移动的危险做出瞬间反应。现有智能体难以同时兼顾两者：仅依赖VLM直接执行动作对于突发事件而言太慢，而将执行委托给固定脚本则使智能体在行动时刻失去视觉感知，导致场景变化时频繁误触发。人类通过将正常的意识控制与条件反射相结合来克服这一问题——心智负责深思熟虑的行动并塑造反射规则，而反射本身仍依赖实时视觉来做出最终的瞬间决策。受这一机制启发，我们提出了ViCoR（视觉条件反射）。在执行常规游戏动作的同时，主VLM定义并更新轻量级的情境引导……
tldr: 该论文提出ViCoR（视觉条件反射）机制，模仿人类“意识控制+条件反射”的行为模式，让VLM智能体在保持深思熟虑规划的同时，通过依赖实时视觉的轻量级反射规则实现对突发危险的瞬间反应，解决了实时环境中规划控制与快速反应难以兼得的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ViCoR (Visual Conditioned Reflex), a mechanism that emulates the human interplay of conscious control and conditioned reflexes, enabling VLM agents to combine deliberate planning with lightweight, live-vision-driven reflexes for split-second reactions to sudden hazards in real-time environments.
